description: Publish a Let's Encrypt DNS-01 challenge: creates a TXT record at _acme-challenge.<label>.<domain> with the token your ACME client printed. Use this to get a certificate without exposing port 80 (for example for a wildcard cert, or a host behind NAT). DNS propagates within seconds, then tell your ACME client to continue. For a normal public web server, HTTP-01 validation needs no DNS record at all.

domain.description: Which domain to act under: 'makes.fyi' (the default) or 'agentdomains.co'. The same label can exist under each, so pass this whenever you are not using the default.

label.description: The subdomain label, without the domain suffix (e.g. 'myapp' for myapp.makes.fyi).

value.description: The challenge token from your ACME client, published verbatim as the TXT value.

name: add_acme_challenge
